candidateIdentity.variantName: 856 UTC fully tegimented on black calf leather strap, WatchBuys SKU SI-084

sourceChecks.note: The exact official product page returned HTTP 403 during independent retrieval. Its current official search result identifies several separately priced leather, solid-bracelet, and silicone configurations rather than one homogeneous attachment variant.

Sinn's current official product sheet independently validates the 856 UTC identity, 40 x 11 mm case, 20 mm band width, 70 g head-only weight, automatic movement, 200 m water resistance, screw-down crown, sapphire crystal, luminous coating, GMT, and date. It also confirms that prices differ by attachment configuration.

Sinn's official North American importer and distributor independently identifies the homogeneous SI-084 configuration as a new, unworn 856 UTC with black Sinn calf-leather strap, SW330-2, 47.5 mm lug-to-lug, USD 2,680 direct price, in-stock immediate shipment, Add to Cart, and manufacturer warranty. Its 70 g weight is explicitly head-only. Verified-owner reports on this exact SKU range across individual rates and subjective lume impressions; one reports eight-hour lume after a one-minute fluorescent charge, but no independent timed protocol corroborates it.

Sinn's official Series 856/857 manual explicitly includes models 856 UTC and 856 S UTC. Its case-level strap instructions direct the user to pass a textile strap through the spring bars on the left and right, independently establishing a spring-bar interface for this exact case family rather than inferring it from the selected leather strap. The accuracy section supplies observation guidance but no numerical factory rate tolerance.
The older official document cited by the extraction also returned HTTP 403, so it does not independently resolve the remaining M1 gaps.

This used Japanese pawnshop listing reports approximately 83.1 g total and a ±10 seconds-per-day three-position timegrapher result, but its model field is only 856, its measured 39 x 39 x 10.6 mm dimensions conflict with Sinn's current 856 UTC sheet, and it does not identify the current SI-084 configuration or a manufacturer guarantee. It cannot close the current full-weight or accuracy gates. Retrieved 2026-08-31.

The official North American distributor's verified-owner comments for the exact 856 UTC strap product include individual approximately ±2 seconds-per-day and +5 seconds-per-day observations. They do not share a timing interval, position/temperature conditions, instrument, or factory guarantee; the observations therefore cannot define the catalogue accuracy bound. The same archive also repeats a subjective eight-hour lume claim after a one-minute fluorescent charge, without a timed brightness series or independent corroboration. Rechecked 2026-08-31.

This recent 856 UTC owner thread contains anecdotes ranging from approximately -5 to +8 seconds per day and an unsourced claim that Sinn regulates to ±5 seconds per day. The comments do not identify the SI-084 strap configuration, share an observation interval or conditions, or provide a manufacturer document, so they cannot close the accuracy gap. Retrieved 2026-08-31.

The extraction left this null; the exact SI-084 authorized-distributor specification and multiple exact 856 UTC records converge on 47.5 mm.

Sinn's exact-series manual supplies no numerical factory tolerance. Exact-SKU verified owners report individual observations from approximately five seconds over a week to +/-2, +4.5, +5.7, and -3 to -4 seconds per day without a shared protocol, so no lower bound is normalized.
Individual exact-SKU owner rates are watch-specific observations rather than a guaranteed range and do not converge under one method; generic SW330-2 tolerances are not substituted.
No common accuracy period can be accepted because the associated exact-SKU observations use different or incompletely described intervals and do not establish a lower/upper tolerance.

The official source establishes luminous coating. Exact-SKU owners variously call it good or not great; one reports eight-hour visibility after a one-minute fluorescent charge, but no independent timed observation corroborates that result, so no repeatable weak/moderate/strong grade is assigned.

The original extraction supplied no interface value. Sinn's official exact-series manual now directly documents case spring bars, supporting the corrected spring_bar classification without inferring it from leather material or buckle type.
Absence of a shock-resistance claim is not evidence that the watch is not shock resistant.

note: Keep as research-only. A source-led pass and independent retrieval now lock the candidate to WatchBuys SKU SI-084: a new, in-stock USD 2,680 black-calf-leather configuration from Sinn's official North American distributor. That exact page resolves 47.5 mm lug-to-lug and SW330-2, while Sinn's exact-series manual directly establishes the case spring bars. The only weight remains 70 g head-only; exact-SKU owner rates include approximately ±2 and +5 seconds per day but lack a shared protocol or guarantee; and exact-SKU lume reports include one eight-hour observation but no independent timed corroboration. A new used 856 listing with 83.1 g total and ±10 seconds-per-day timegrapher results conflicts on dimensions and model identity, so it is rejected rather than substituted. Full configured weight, accuracy, and lume remain null.
